facts.claim: Le Lapérouse (Ponant): Entered service 2018; 37,000 GT; 184 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 217 m length; Explorer class.
Le Lapérouse is the lead ship of the Ponant Explorers-class of cruise ships operated by Ponant.
Each member of the class has been allocated the name of a famous French explorer, and Le Lapérouse is named after naval officer Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse.
